# endoflife.ai — EOL Risk Overview
End-of-life risk for every product endoflife.ai tracks, pushed daily by the endoflife.ai exporter as `endoflife.risk_score` (0–100), `endoflife.days_until_eol` and `endoflife.kev_factor_score`. Score methodology: EOL recency, attack surface, CISA KEV exposure, extended-support availability — https://endoflife.ai/risk-score

1.title: Products tracked
1.query:
timeseries score = avg(endoflife.risk_score), by:{product}
| summarize products = count()

2.title: Average EOL Risk Score
2.query:
timeseries score = avg(endoflife.risk_score)
| fieldsAdd avg_score = arrayAvg(score)
| fields avg_score

3.title: Past end of life
3.query:
timeseries days = avg(endoflife.days_until_eol), by:{product}
| fieldsAdd d = arrayAvg(days)
| filter d < 0
| summarize past_eol = count()

singleValue.label: Products already past their EOL date

4.title: KEV-exposed products
4.query:
timeseries kev = avg(endoflife.kev_factor_score), by:{product}
| fieldsAdd k = arrayAvg(kev)
| filter k > 0
| summarize kev_exposed = count()

singleValue.label: Products with an active CISA KEV entry

5.title: Products by risk grade

6.title: Highest-risk products
6.query:
timeseries score = avg(endoflife.risk_score), by:{product, grade, eol_label, kev_active}
| fieldsAdd risk_score = round(arrayAvg(score))
| fields product, grade, eol_label, kev_active, risk_score
| sort risk_score desc
| limit 25

7.title: Approaching end of life (next 90 days)
7.query: timeseries days = avg(endoflife.days_until_next_eol), by:{product, version, eol_date, grade}, from: now()-30h | fieldsAdd days_until_eol = round(arrayLast(days)) | filter eol_date >= formatTimestamp(now(), format:"yyyy-MM-dd") and days_until_eol >= 0 and days_until_eol <= 90 | fields product, version, eol_date, days_until_eol, grade | sort days_until_eol asc, product asc

8.title: Past end of life and actively exploited (CISA KEV)
8.query:
timeseries { kev = avg(endoflife.kev_factor_score), days = avg(endoflife.days_until_eol) }, by:{product, grade}
| fieldsAdd kev_factor = round(arrayAvg(kev)), days_since_eol = round(arrayAvg(days)) * -1
| filter kev_factor > 0 and days_since_eol > 0
| fields product, grade, days_since_eol, kev_factor
| sort kev_factor desc

9.title: EOL Risk Score by product

10.title: Average EOL Risk Score over time
